peers.name: playwright-stealth-verify
peers.description: Check whether a Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium or CDP-driven browser presents a coherent fingerprint, using liarjs as a library against a Page you already have - navigator.webdriver, HeadlessChrome tokens, worker versus main-thread identity, patched-API integrity, WebGL versus WebGPU GPU identity. Use when asked whether an automated browser looks like a normal one, when a headless setup or a stealth plugin's effect needs measuring rather than assuming, or when an assertion on fingerprint quality belongs in a test suite.

peers.name: fingerprint-failure-triage
peers.description: Read a liarjs fingerprint report and attribute each failing check to the component that produced it - what the check id measures, whether the signal comes from the launch configuration, the page-modifying layer, the network path or the machine image, and which failures are inherent to headless or datacenter environments. Use when a fingerprint scan came back with a low score, or when a check id such as webdriver, worker-consistency, gpu-triad, native-integrity or tz needs explaining.

peers.name: fingerprint-ci-gate
peers.description: Gate a build on browser fingerprint regressions with liarjs - save a baseline scan as JSON, diff later runs against it, and fail the job when the consistency score falls below a floor. Use when asked to add a fingerprint or headless-detection check to GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or another pipeline, to catch a regression in a Chromium build or scraping harness before it ships, or to track how a fingerprint score changes across commits.

en.tagline: Check a browser fingerprint for internal contradictions
en.summary: browser-fingerprint-audit runs the liarjs CLI against a browser and reports where its fingerprint contradicts the network view of the same request. It checks in-browser probes such as canvas, WebGL, audio, fonts, WebRTC and timezone against TLS, HTTP and ASN data seen at the edge. The result is a score from 0 to 100 and a list of failing checks.
problem: A browser reports whatever its JavaScript says, but it cannot change the network path it uses. A profile that claims one timezone, GPU or platform while its IP, ASN or TLS handshake points elsewhere shows the mismatch only when both sides are compared.

Without a scan, checking this means reading raw probe output and guessing. This skill runs the probes, fetches the network view for the same request, and lists each contradiction with a check id, a deduction and a one-sentence explanation.
fit: Checking whether a browser profile is self-consistent
Comparing a spoofed profile against a real browser
Seeing how canvas, WebGL, audio and font fingerprints look in a given browser
unfit: Predicting whether a specific site will challenge the browser, since IP reputation and account behaviour are not visible to a local scan
Comparing scans over time or failing a build on a regression (use fingerprint-ci-gate instead)
steps: By default, the CLI launches a throwaway Chrome with a fresh temporary profile.
It runs the in-browser probes on about:blank, or on a page you pass with --page.
It has the browser fetch https://liarjs.dev/api/net.json, so the edge reports IP, ASN, HTTP and TLS details for that request, unless you use --offline.
It compares the browser view with the network view and deducts points for each failing check, starting from 100.
It prints only failing checks unless you pass --all, and saves the full result when you pass --json.
When you need to know what a check id measures, read references/checks.md, which lists all 40 checks.

zh.tagline: 检查浏览器指纹内部是否自相矛盾
zh.summary: browser-fingerprint-audit 调用 liarjs 命令行工具扫描浏览器，找出浏览器指纹与同一请求的网络视图之间的矛盾。它将画布、WebGL、音频、字体、WebRTC 和时区等浏览器内探测结果，与边缘节点看到的 TLS、HTTP 和 ASN 数据进行比对。结果是一个 0 到 100 的分数，以及未通过的检查项列表。
problem: 浏览器会上报 JavaScript 给出的任何数据，但无法改变它所使用的网络路径。如果一个配置文件声称的时区、显卡或平台，与 IP、ASN 或 TLS 握手所指向的结果不一致，只有两边对照时才能看出问题。
没有扫描时，检查这类问题只能阅读原始探测输出再自行判断。这个 skill 会运行探测，获取同一请求的网络视图，并为每一处矛盾列出检查 id、扣分和一句说明。
fit: 检查浏览器配置文件是否自洽
对比伪造配置与真实浏览器
查看某个浏览器中画布、WebGL、音频和字体指纹的表现
unfit: 预测某个网站是否会挑战该浏览器，本地扫描看不到 IP 信誉和账号行为
跨时间比较扫描结果，或因回归让构建失败（应改用 fingerprint-ci-gate）
steps: 默认情况下，命令行工具会启动一个使用全新临时配置的 Chrome，扫描结束后即丢弃。
它在 about:blank 上运行浏览器内探测，或在你通过 --page 指定的页面上运行。
除非使用 --offline，它会让浏览器请求 https://liarjs.dev/api/net.json，由边缘节点返回该请求的 IP、ASN、HTTP 和 TLS 细节。
它将浏览器视图与网络视图对比，每个未通过的检查从 100 分中扣分。
默认只打印未通过的检查，加上 --all 会显示通过的项；加上 --json 会保存完整结果。
需要了解某个检查 id 的含义时，可阅读 references/checks.md，其中列出了全部 40 项检查。
